origin.description: Apply a function to each run of equal index values.
origin.usage: ctapply(X, INDEX, FUN, ..., MERGE = c, .SAFE = TRUE)

arguments.name: X
arguments.text: An integer, real, character, or generic vector.

arguments.name: INDEX
arguments.text: An integer, real, or character vector of the same length. A factor is its codes.

arguments.name: FUN
arguments.text: Called with each contiguous slice and the extra arguments.
Passed through to FUN without recycling.

arguments.name: MERGE
arguments.text: Combines the results. The default is c(). NULL is an error.

arguments.name: .SAFE
arguments.text: FALSE warns on R 4.5 and still uses a fresh slice for each group.

origin.details: A new group starts wherever the index value changes. A real NA is not equal to the next real NA, so each one is its own group and the name is nan. An integer NA is one group and the name is -2147483648. A longer result is named with the group name and a suffix, the way c() names its arguments.
origin.value: The combined results, with a name for each value.
